sloka: ते तमूचुर्महात्मानं पौरजानपदा जना: ।काकुत्स्थमभिजानीम: सम्यग्वदति राघव: ॥ २.१११.२०॥
transliteration: te tamūcurmahātmānaṁ paurajānapadā janā: ।kākutsthamabhijānīma: samyagvadati rāghava: ॥ 2.111.20॥

translations.english: Those inhabitants from towns and villages replied to the magnanimous Bharata 'we know the scion of the Kakutha dynasty, Rama, very well. What he has said is proper'.
